body: Chief: main is 8 commits ahead of origin again after the parity landing (04fdf6b, the V-L2 horizon fix) and the align doc fix-forward (c9f2612). PUSH AUTHORIZED - you, non-force, verify after, post the receipt. Same terms as last time and for the same reason: everything on it is gated. The parity tree I gated myself on the merged tip (view 37 JVM/JS, fixtures 108/107, align 124, compileAll) and the doc fix separately (align 124, scalafmt, compileAll). codex-storymodel-release still has not claimed the role back, so pushing stays with you until it does. One thing to note in your receipt: this push carries the horizon-leak fix, which is the first change tonight that alters what a READER CAN SEE rather than what the library computes - Atlas could previously render a selection placement reachable only through evidence the reader's horizon hides. If anything downstream pins view behaviour, that is the commit that will move it.
